# teams_tenant_trusted_ip_address (Data Source)

Look up an existing TenantTrustedIPAddress object. Set identity to select it.

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `ip_address` (String) Maps to the -IPAddress parameter.
